actions.action: Bottom-water thoroughly by soaking pot 15-30 minutes, then drain
Move plant out of direct sun to bright indirect light
Boost humidity with pebble tray, humidifier, or grouping plants
Trim crispy or fully brown leaves
If it doesn't recover, check roots and trim black mushy ones
